about: Step 1 survey result, from docs/pickleball-rankings/SOURCE-SURVEY.md. Every outside page fetch was blocked by the session's network proxy on 2026-11-08, so no terms clause is quoted yet; 'why' lines below say what is known and what is not. Link-only means PointCast links out and copies no names or numbers.
verdict: Current US national and pro results are not reusable by PointCast today. No national, pro or global source is verified as usable. The only results in the rankings come from the El Segundo 25-mile ladder's open feed.

usable.name: El Segundo 25-mile ladder (elsegundo.xyz)
usable.why: Open feed and recipe published for reuse; it takes organizer-published results only (CAPA bracket sheets, Diamond League).

link_only.name: USA Pickleball National Championships
link_only.why: usapickleball.org is link-only; per a search snippet its past results sit on PickleballTournaments.com or PickleballBrackets.com, also link-only.

link_only.name: PPA Tour
link_only.why: ppatour.com and pickleball.com are link-only; their terms reportedly bar extracting data (not re-read: blocked).
